notes.title: Fixed some issues caused by the route tracking program 修复由路线追踪程序导致的一些问题
notes.notes: [p]The previous route tracking program had a certain degree of vulnerability, which may cause the vehicle's position to teleport in a few cases. Now fixed.[/p][p]之前的路线追踪程序存在一定程度的漏洞，可能在少数情况下导致车辆位置瞬移。现在已经修复。[/p]

notes.title: Optimized and fixed several program issues 优化和修复了若干程序问题
notes.notes: [p]Optimized and fixed several program issues, including game reset issues, key display issues, etc.[/p][p]优化和修复了若干程序问题，包括游戏重置问题，键位显示问题等[/p]

notes.title: In-game menu has now been added to the prologue 现已为序章增加了游戏内菜单
notes.notes: [p]The in-game menu has now been added to the prologue, allowing players to adjust settings or skip the prologue during this section. Previously, the in-game menu was only available after completing the prologue and officially starting the game.[/p][p][/p][p]现已为序章增加了游戏内菜单，可用于在序章中调整设置或跳过序章。此前，游戏内菜单仅在完成序章并正式进入游戏后可用。[/p]
